subject: renderUI() fails to update textarea contents

messages.author: d8af3566e6f9ffa7
messages.subject: renderUI() fails to update textarea contents
parts:
Please have a look at my code below. For some reason adding lines to textarea input works perfectly, but when I try to replace the whole contents of it by loading previously saved data from a global variable, everything stops workings. Please pay attention that cat(OUT) in server.R prints correct textarea value, but shiny fails to replace the previous value with a new one and "Add to textarea" button stops working as well after "Load textarea" button was pressed.

server.R

require(shiny)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  assign('SETTINGS', '', envir=.GlobalEnv)
  save.settings <- observe({
    if(input$save>0) {
      isolate({
        assign('SETTINGS', input$txtarea, envir=.GlobalEnv)
      })
    }
  })
  
  assign('prev.load', 0, envir=.GlobalEnv)
  output$RENDER <- renderUI({
    # Load values
    if(get('prev.load', envir=.GlobalEnv)<input$load) {
      # If to uncomment this part with isolate(), then LOAD works, but just once, though ADD stops working anyway
      # isolate({
      OUT <- get('SETTINGS', envir=.GlobalEnv)
      assign('prev.load', input$load, envir=.GlobalEnv)
      # })
    # Add line to textarea
    } else if(input$add>0) {
      isolate({
        OUT <- paste0(ifelse(input$txtarea=='','',paste0(input$txtarea,'\n')),input$val)
      })
    } else {
      OUT <- ''
    }
    # print the contents of OUT
    cat(OUT)
    tags$textarea(id="txtarea", rows=15, OUT)
  })
  
})


ui.R

require(shiny)
require(shinyIncubator)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  headerPanel("Settings"),
  
  sidebarPanel(
    numericInput("val", "Value", 0),br(),
    actionButton("add","Add to textarea"),br(),br(),
    uiOutput("RENDER"),
    actionButton("save", "Save textarea"),
    actionButton("load", "Load textarea")
  ),
  
  mainPanel(
    
  )
))

messages.subject: Re: renderUI() fails to update textarea contents
parts: It seems that that it's a caching issue. Replacing "OUT <- get('SETTINGS', envir=.GlobalEnv)" with "OUT <- paste0(get('SETTINGS', envir=.GlobalEnv),Sys.time())" makes renderUI() load saved values, but "Add to textarea" still stops working after pressing "Load textarea".
